observations: Three photos show the same JBL retail box on a glass surface.
The box is orange and white with the JBL and Harman logos visible.
Text on the box includes 'DARE TO LISTEN' and 'Bluetooth v5.1'.
An image of a cylindrical black speaker is printed on the box.
The model name 'Xtreme 3' is not clearly legible in any photo.
No actual speaker unit, ports, or labels are visible outside the box.

Model name is not legible on the box in photos 0-2.
Battery life cannot be checked from photos.
Ingress protection rating cannot be verified from photos.
PartyBoost feature cannot be confirmed from photos of the box.

risks.risk: The speaker may not power on or may have a dead battery.

risks.proof: Photo of the model label on the speaker unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unverified JBL portable speaker

Video of the speaker powering on and playing music
